development_validation.reason: The nine gold-clean base tasks have already been manually inspected task-by-task and their failure traces, test choices, premature submissions, and outcomes shaped the verifier-LoRA hypothesis.
development_validation.claim_limit: This development set supports diagnostics for Rich and FastAPI only; it does not support Requests or broad cross-repository generalization claims.

blind_evaluation.candidate_source: tasks currently in the training side of verifier-lora-split-v0 that have not been harvested, manually inspected, or otherwise development-seen
blind_evaluation.selection_rule: Freeze task IDs from metadata only, then allow automated harness/gold-control eligibility screening. Do not inspect base-model blind failure traces, blind reference patches, or task-level blind outcomes before the verifier adapter is frozen.

promotion.stop_rule: If verifier-LoRA v0 fails the frozen blind evaluation, stop v0 instead of immediately sweeping rank, epochs, learning rate, or other hyperparameters.
